literal: Enmity and friendship the eye will tell, of the eye the variety those who understand if obtained.
translation: The eye will reveal both enmity and friendship, if one secures the help of those who understand its varied expressions.
modern: கண்களின் குறிப்புகளை அறியும் ஆற்றல் உடையவர்களைத் துணையாகப் பெற்றால், ஒருவரின் பகைமையையும் நட்பையும் அவர் கண்களே காட்டிக் கொடுத்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the communicative power of the eyes in revealing a person's true feelings. The words pagaimaiyum and kenmaiyum represent the two extremes of human relationships: enmity and friendship. The phrase kannin vagaimai refers to the subtle varieties of expressions the eye can take. If a leader secures the counsel of those who can read these expressions, as indicated by unarvar perin, the eyes of others will openly declare their hidden intentions.
